```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
stakeholder = "config/stakeholders/public_health_expert.json"
classes_file = "config/pathogen_class.csv"
out = "out"
```

```{python}
# Setup: reads the outputs of harmonise.py / checks.py (run `bash run_all.sh data/Data out` first).
# Series selection is shared with report.py, so the HTML and this Quarto report give identical numbers.
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from report import select_series, pct, fmt_pct, COL

out = Path(out)
cfg = json.loads(Path(stakeholder).read_text())
classes = pd.read_csv(classes_file).set_index("topic").to_dict("index")
d = pd.read_parquet(out / "harmonised.parquet")
reg = pd.read_csv(out / "datasets.csv")
checks = pd.read_csv(out / "checks.csv") if (out / "checks.csv").exists() else pd.DataFrame()

y0, y1 = cfg["years"]; ref = cfg.get("reference_year"); years = list(range(y0, y1 + 1))
xs = [ref] + years if ref else years
excl = set(cfg.get("exclude_from_group_totals", []))
sens = set(cfg.get("sensitivity_exclude", []))
base_y = cfg.get("index_base_year", ref or y0)
lab = lambda t: classes.get(t, {}).get("label", t)

used, skipped, trace = select_series(d, cfg, classes)
main_cls = cfg["classes_in_main_comparison"]
main = [u for u in used if u["cls"] in main_cls]
synd = [u for u in used if u["cls"] not in main_cls]
order = sorted(main, key=lambda u: (u["cls"] != "viral", u["label"]))

def group_sum(c, drop):
    ss = [u["series"].value for u in main if u["cls"] == c and u["topic"] not in drop]
    return pd.concat(ss, axis=1).sum(axis=1, min_count=1).reindex(xs) if ss else pd.Series(dtype=float)
grp = {c: group_sum(c, excl) for c in main_cls}
gv, gb = grp.get("viral"), grp.get("bacterial")

tab = []
for u in order:
    s = u["series"]; v = {y: s.value.get(y) for y in xs}
    ch = pct(v[y0], v[y1])
    tab.append({"Disease": u["label"] + (" *" if u["topic"] in excl else ""), "Class": u["cls"],
                **{str(y): v[y] for y in xs},
                f"{y0}→{y1}": ch, f"vs {ref}": pct(v[ref], v[y1]),
                f"per 100k ({y1})": s.inc100k.get(y1),
                "Peak": int(s.value.reindex(years).idxmax()),
                "Trend": "rising" if ch is not None and ch > 15 else "falling" if ch is not None and ch < -15 else "stable"})
tdf = pd.DataFrame(tab)
pub = reg.publishing_date.dropna().max()
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"**Question:** {cfg['question']}\n")
print(f"*Source: FOPH Infectious Disease Dashboard (IDD) exports, published up to {pub}. "
      f"National level (CH + FL), all ages, all sexes. Period {y0}–{y1}, reference year {ref}.*")
```

## Headline numbers

```{python}
#| output: asis
cards = [
    (f"Viral (excl. {', '.join(map(lab, excl))}) vs {ref}", fmt_pct(pct(gv.get(ref), gv.get(y1))),
     f"{y0}→{y1}: {fmt_pct(pct(gv.get(y0), gv.get(y1)))}"),
    (f"Bacterial vs {ref}", fmt_pct(pct(gb.get(ref), gb.get(y1))),
     f"{y0}→{y1}: {fmt_pct(pct(gb.get(y0), gb.get(y1)))}"),
]
cov = next((u for u in main if u["topic"] in excl), None)
if cov is not None:
    cs = cov["series"].value
    cards.append((f"{cov['label']} notifications", fmt_pct(pct(cs.get(y0), cs.get(y1))),
                  f"peak {int(cs.reindex(years).idxmax())}: {cs.max():,.0f}"))
top = tdf.sort_values(f"{y0}→{y1}", ascending=False).iloc[0]
cards.append(("Strongest rise", top.Disease, f"{fmt_pct(top[f'{y0}→{y1}'])} since {y0}"))

print("::: {.grid}")
for k, v, s in cards:
    print(f"::: {{.g-col-6 .g-col-md-3}}\n::: {{.callout-note appearance='minimal'}}\n"
          f"{k}\n\n**{v}**\n\n<small>{s}</small>\n:::\n:::")
print(":::")
```

## Key findings

```{python}
#| output: asis
risers = tdf.sort_values(f"{y0}→{y1}", ascending=False).head(3)
fallers = tdf.sort_values(f"{y0}→{y1}").head(2)
bact_top = tdf[tdf.Class == "bacterial"].sort_values(f"{y0}→{y1}", ascending=False).Disease.head(3)
b = [
    f"Bacterial notifications changed {fmt_pct(pct(gb.get(y0), gb.get(y1)))} between {y0} and {y1} "
    f"and are {fmt_pct(pct(gb.get(ref), gb.get(y1)))} vs {ref}. Main contributors: {', '.join(bact_top)}.",
    f"Viral notifications excluding {', '.join(map(lab, excl))} changed {fmt_pct(pct(gv.get(y0), gv.get(y1)))} between {y0} and {y1}.",
]
if sens:
    g2 = group_sum("viral", excl | sens)
    b.append(f"Excluding {', '.join(map(lab, sens))} as well, viral notifications are "
             f"{fmt_pct(pct(g2.get(ref), g2.get(y1)))} vs {ref}.")
b.append("Largest relative increases: " + "; ".join(f"{r.Disease} {fmt_pct(r[f'{y0}→{y1}'])}" for _, r in risers.iterrows()) + ".")
b.append("Largest decreases: " + "; ".join(f"{r.Disease} {fmt_pct(r[f'{y0}→{y1}'])}" for _, r in fallers.iterrows()) + ".")
print("\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in b))
```

## Viral vs bacterial, indexed

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Sum of notified cases per group, pre-COVID base year = 100. Dashed lines also remove the sensitivity-excluded topics (influenza)."
plt.rcParams.update({"axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": .25})
f, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.8))
for c, s in grp.items():
    n = sum(1 for u in main if u["cls"] == c and u["topic"] not in excl)
    ax.plot(xs, s / s.loc[base_y] * 100, marker="o", lw=2.2, color=COL[c], label=f"{c.title()} (n={n})")
    sub_n = sum(1 for u in main if u["cls"] == c and u["topic"] not in excl | sens)
    if sens and sub_n < n:
        s2 = group_sum(c, excl | sens)
        ax.plot(xs, s2 / s2.loc[base_y] * 100, ls="--", lw=1.6, color=COL[c], alpha=.7,
                label=f"{c.title()} excl. {', '.join(map(lab, sens))}")
ax.axhline(100, color=COL["ref"], lw=1, ls=":")
ax.set_xticks(xs, [str(x) for x in xs]); ax.set_ylabel(f"Index {base_y} = 100")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="upper left")
display(f); plt.close(f)
```

## Per disease: incidence per 100,000

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Dotted line = reference-year level. Orange = viral, teal = bacterial."
n = len(order); ncol = 3; nrow = -(-n // ncol)
f, axs = plt.subplots(nrow, ncol, figsize=(8, 2.2 * nrow), squeeze=False)
for ax, u in zip(axs.flat, order):
    s = u["series"]; col = "inc100k" if s.inc100k.notna().any() else "value"
    ax.plot(years, s[col].reindex(years), marker="o", ms=3, lw=1.8, color=COL[u["cls"]])
    if ref in s.index:
        ax.axhline(s.loc[ref, col], color=COL["ref"], lw=1, ls=":")
    ax.set_title(u["label"], loc="left", fontsize=9, color=COL[u["cls"]], fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_xticks(years, [str(y)[2:] for y in years]); ax.set_ylim(bottom=0); ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
for ax in list(axs.flat)[n:]: ax.axis("off")
f.tight_layout(); display(f); plt.close(f)
```

## Change table

```{python}
fmt = {str(y): "{:,.0f}" for y in xs}
fmt.update({f"{y0}→{y1}": "{:+.0f}%", f"vs {ref}": "{:+.0f}%", f"per 100k ({y1})": "{:.1f}"})
(tdf.style.format(fmt, na_rep="–").hide(axis="index")
    .map(lambda t: "color:#b91c1c;font-weight:600" if t == "rising" else
                   "color:#15803d;font-weight:600" if t == "falling" else "", subset=["Trend"]))
```

\* excluded from group totals. Rising/falling = change of more than ±15%. Every value is listed with its source file and row in the trace table below.

## Sources and traceability

```{python}
#| output: asis
regv = reg[reg.status.str.startswith("ok")].copy()
print(f"{len(regv)} unique datasets harmonised; {(reg.status == 'duplicate_skipped').sum()} duplicate downloads skipped by file fingerprint.")
regv["used"] = regv.dataset_id.isin(used_ids).map({True: "yes", False: "no"})
regv["file"] = regv.source_file.map(lambda p: f"{Path(p).parent.name}/data.csv")
regv["sha256"] = regv.sha256.str[:12]
regv["source_system"] = regv.source_system.str.replace("_", " ").str.replace("reporting system", "").str.strip()
print(regv[["topic", "source_system", "publishing_date", "used", "file", "sha256", "rows"]]
      .style.hide(axis="index").set_table_attributes('style="font-size:11px"').to_html())
```
